problem: SavedState alone does not preserve deliberate close/reopen. A frozen Save command must precede business writes and survive uncertain acknowledgement.
implementation: Internal typed owner/version/checkpoint/pending/recovery types; existing public DraftStore and AppDependencies signatures unchanged.
AppContainer lazily owns noBackupFilesDir/draft-checkpoints; no startup redirect, Room/schema/export/sync change.
Shared ordered off-main IO; fsync temporary then atomic replacement without unsafe overwrite fallback.
Owner-bound revision/generation checks and payload-free clear tombstones reject stale/queued writes.
Durable frozen Save admission; duplicate reservation rejected. Repository inspection supplies exact/uncommitted/conflict/unavailable outcome.
Only proven uncommitted commands become Retryable. Retry retains exact command; resume editing retains authored fields.
Accepted command remains fenced when cleanup fails. Clear refuses uncertain pending work.
Generation advance requires existing restore write coordination; old owners require area reconciliation and fresh pending inspection.
Strict version/owner/revision/codec checks; bounded reads and redacted result descriptions. Unreadable checkpoints retained without automatic erase or replay.
Strict UTF8 decoding rejects malformed bytes; valid Unicode/multiline input remains exact.
Validate JSON strings/keys and identity UTF16 before acceptance; strict encoder prevents character substitution in a frozen draft or command.
